name: Prisma
description: Manage Prisma Postgres databases, connection strings, backups, schemas, SQL queries, and Object Storage. Search the official Prisma documentation and manage resources in your selected workspace. Sign in with your Prisma account to connect. The connector can read and change resources in that workspace.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Prisma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Prisma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.prisma.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Prisma MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prisma lists 18 MCP tools, including create_object_store_bucket, create_object_store_bucket_key, create_prisma_postgres_connection_string, create_prisma_postgres_database, create_prisma_postgres_recovery, delete_object_store_bucket, delete_object_store_bucket_key, delete_prisma_postgres_connection_string, delete_prisma_postgres_database, execute_prisma_postgres_schema_update, execute_sql_query, and fetch_workspace_details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Prisma?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Prisma in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Prisma requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Prisma is developed by Prisma. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
